exposure: Perinatal Anxiety Screening Scale (PASS) - Chinese version
outcome: Psychometric properties (confirmatory factor analysis, internal consistency reliability, convergent validity)
cohort: A total of 494 women in the antenatal and postnatal phase (268 antenatal and 186 postnatal) were recruited from two hospitals in Sichuan Province, China.
finding: The Chinese-PASS demonstrated reasonably adequate validity and reliability, making it suitable for screening anxiety disorders among women during the perinatal period.
cross-section timing: Participants were recruited between March 2023 and July 2023, during their antenatal and postnatal phases.
